# Vincenzo Picciuolo. Founder, Technology Architect, Inventor and Author

> Canonical portfolio index for Vincenzo Picciuolo and his selected public work. Updated 2026-11-16.

## Identity

Vincenzo Picciuolo is a technology executive, founder, technology architect, inventor and author based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. His work spans artificial intelligence, AI agents, distributed infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud systems, developer platforms and product architecture.

* Official portfolio: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/
* Executive CV: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/cv/
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/vpicciuolo/
* GitHub: https://github.com/vpicciuolo
* X: https://x.com/vpicciuolo
* HORNO Space profile: https://horno.to/vip
* Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/vpicciuolo

## Book

* 9600 BPS: The Start · Curiosity Never Had an Off Switch: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/book/
* Author: Vincenzo Picciuolo
* ASIN: B0HF19FMGK
* Amazon: https://www.amazon.it/dp/B0HF19FMGK
* Themes: curiosity, the last analog generation, electronics, early computing, 9600 BPS internet, music, telecommunications, distributed infrastructure, blockchain, artificial intelligence and human attention.

* Build catalog: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/builds/

* GitHub is the authoritative source for current code and repository licensing.
* Public visibility does not imply an open source license. Check each repository README and license.
* The portfolio intentionally excludes several public repositories from its catalog and discovery files at the owner's request.
* The evidence index separates independent outside listings from company owned primary sources.
